name: Zacharias
summary: A priest who, with his wife Elisabeth, had no children into old age. The angel Gabriel told him he would have a son, John, and because he did not believe, he could not speak until the boy was named.

key_moments.title: An Angel at the Altar
key_moments.description: While Zacharias burned incense in the temple, an angel appeared beside the altar. The angel told him his prayer was heard and Elisabeth would bear him a son named John.

key_moments.title: Unable to Speak
key_moments.description: Zacharias asked how he could know this, since he and his wife were old. Gabriel said that because he did not believe, he would not be able to speak until it happened, and he came out unable to talk.

key_moments.title: Writing the Name John
key_moments.description: When the baby was eight days old, Zacharias asked for a writing tablet and wrote that his name was John. At once he could speak again, and he praised God.

key_moments.title: Zacharias Prophesies
key_moments.description: Filled with the Holy Ghost, Zacharias blessed God for coming to save His people. He said his son would be called the prophet of the Highest and go before the Lord to prepare His ways.
